column1: message
We answer the phone ourselves — via freephone in the UK and toll-free in the US.\n\nThere's no charge for calling, and no automated systems.
You don't need a clan connection to wear a kilt.\n\nChoosing one you genuinely like has always been acceptable.
If you call us, you'll speak to a real person who knows our products properly.\n\nWe're here to help, and we don't rush conversations.
Many family names are linked to several tartans, not just one.\n\nTradition is often broader than people expect.
Our customer service is simply part of what we do.\n\nThere's no charge for it, and no obligation attached.
Kilts have always adapted to how people live and work.\n\nChange is part of the tradition, not a break from it.
We began in 1995, and have been working with kilts and tartans ever since.\n\nThat depth of experience shapes everything we do.
Tweed was originally chosen for durability and comfort, not fashion.\n\nThat practicality is still part of its appeal.
We were the world's first company to sell kilts and tartan.\n\nThat long experience still shapes how we work today.
Formal and informal Highland dress aren't opposites.\n\nThey're points on a spectrum.
We offer by far the widest choice of tartans in the world.\n\nWe're always happy to help you narrow it down.
Not all tartans are ancient — and that's not a problem.\n\nNew designs have been part of Scottish dress for generations.
Our team deals with Scottish heritage goods every day.\n\nThat long familiarity makes choosing easier.
Clans and families didn't all wear identical dress.\n\nVariety has always existed.
We ship worldwide and support customers every day from the UK, the US, and beyond.
A kilt should feel secure and comfortable before it looks impressive.\n\nFit matters more than people realise.
Our products are authentic and made with care.\n\nMostly in Scotland or the wider UK.
Wearing tweed well is mostly about comfort and confidence.\n\nIt was never meant to feel stiff or restrictive.
We don't sell cheap imitations or mass-produced knock-offs.\n\nQuality and provenance matter to us.
Many people wear tartan to mark an occasion rather than a lineage.\n\nThat, too, has long precedent.
We publish dispatch times to be clear and honest.\n\nIf you're working to a deadline, it's always worth asking.
In many cases we can meet faster timescales once we understand what you need.
Accessories in Highland dress developed for practical reasons first.\n\nDecoration came later.
If timing matters, a short conversation often makes things possible.\n\nThings that don't always show on a webpage.
There's no requirement to own everything at once.\n\nHighland dress is often built up over time.
We're always happy to help you navigate our range.\n\nOr suggest options for an occasion.
Tweed and tartan have always worked together.\n\nThey grew from the same landscape and needs.
If you prefer, we can place an order with you over the phone.\n\nOr help you do so yourself.
Understanding the background makes choosing easier.\n\nBut enjoyment has always been the point.
